packages.title: Node 26 toolchain, pinned dependencies, worker-node test project, core under Node, gate
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §3.1, §3.9, §15.1.

- Pin Node 26.12.1 in .nvmrc, set `engines.node` to `>=26.12.0`, and make CI use .nvmrc.
- Pin exactly, choosing the newest release at least 7 days old and recording the choice in the ADR §3 tables: `@atproto/oauth-client-node` 0.5.10, `ws` 8.22.0, `@types/ws`, `undici` 8.12.2 (it must equal `process.versions.undici`), `fflate`, `esbuild` 0.28.2 (direct devDependency), `lastfm-ts-api` 2.6.2 (dev only, the real-client e2e) and `@types/node` 26.x. Regenerate package-lock.json.
- Add the `worker-node` vitest project in worker/vitest.node.config.ts: `environment: 'node'`, `include: ['test/node/**/*.test.ts']`, `sequence.groupOrder: 1`. Exclude `test/node/**` from worker/vitest.modules.config.ts.
- Switch packages/core to `environment: 'node'`; its 34 tests must pass unchanged under Node's ICU (Unicode 17).
- worker/tsconfig.json gains `node` types next to `@cloudflare/workers-types`. If the two conflict, move the Workers-only files (src/index.ts, src/do/index-do.ts, src/scheduled.ts, src/env.ts) into worker/tsconfig.workers.json until N6-02 deletes them.
- scripts/check-ts.sh gains a step that runs `npx tsx scripts/build-server.ts --check` when that file exists (it arrives in N2-01).

Only this package regenerates the lockfile in wave 0. Later packages that add or remove dependencies own package-lock.json in their own wave.

packages.description:
ADR 0005 §5.7, §6.1–§6.3, §7, §8, §16.

- **lexicons/scrobble.json:** add the §6.2 optional fields with their limits. Nothing else changes; no field becomes required.
- **lexicons/love.json:** new, with key tid; artist, track and createdAt required; album and recordingMbid optional. Fixture id `com.example.atmusic.love`.
- **api/openapi.yaml → 1.2.0:** Scrobble and ScrobbleInput get the optional fields. Add the §5.7 routes (auth, writes, operations, account, credentials, links, imports, lastfm/authorize) with Operation, Accepted, Session, Account, Link, ImportJob and Credentials schemas, cookie security, and the 401, 403 csrf_failed, 409 idempotency_conflict and 503 publication_disabled responses. Remove the static client-metadata asset row and document the dynamic /oauth/client-metadata.json and /oauth/jwks.json.
- **docs/planning/API.md:** add the v1.2 amendment paragraph; narrow 'no route reads a session' to 'no v1.1 read route'.
- **docs/planning/AMENDMENTS-node.md:** B1–B18 issue-amendment texts in the AMENDMENTS-workers.md format, including the TESTING.md harness wording (B10).
- **docs/compat/lastfm.md and docs/compat/listenbrainz.md:** the client-facing protocol specifications of §7 and §8: methods, parameters, errors and client setup for Pano, multi-scrobbler, Web Scrobbler, Navidrome, Jellyfin and Music Assistant.
- **ADR 0002 and ADR 0004:** status lines say which sections ADR 0005 supersedes.
- **scripts/validate_case_map.py:** accept test ids declared in docs/planning/node-waves.json as well as workers-waves.json (new `--node-waves` option, default path).
- **scripts/validate_contracts.py:** validate love.json, check that every scrobble.json property other than the required four is optional, and check the new examples against their schemas.

packages.title: IndexCore extraction, Host interface, AppServices, extension timers
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §2.2, §3.1, §3.3.

- **IndexCore.** Move the IndexDO body (index-do.ts:276-600) into `IndexCore(config, host: Host, extensions: CoreExtension[])`. `Host` is `{db, alarm, connectJetstream, transport, backup?, log, clock, random}`. index-do.ts becomes a thin wrapper that builds a Workers Host and delegates, so the workerd suites keep passing.
- **IndexRpc** (contracts.ts) gains `adminBackup()`. `adminPitr` stays until N6-02, and a host without a backup or PITR port answers `not_supported`.
- **AppServices** (worker/src/app/services.ts) is an empty interface that features extend by declaration merging.
- **Timers** (timers.ts): `TIMER_NAMES` gains outbox, forward, import, oauth-keepalive, expiry-sweep and backup. Extension handlers run after the core timers in that fixed order. A name with no handler is never armed. A throwing handler is re-armed with backoff and never blocks the core timers.

packages.title: Pinned outbound transport (DNS-answer checks at connect time)
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §3.5.

`pinnedTransport({lookup?, caps})` returns a Transport over an undici Agent whose `connect.lookup` applies `isAllowedAddress` (net/url-policy.ts) to every answer and connects only to the checked address. The existing SafeFetch policy wraps it unchanged. Failures are `TransportError {code: 'blocked_address'|'dns'|'connect'|'timeout'|'too_large'|'redirect'}`, never a raw TypeError.

The DoH HTTP pre-check is not used on this path; net/doh.ts stays for handle TXT. Tests inject the lookup function. No real DNS and no real network.

packages.title: Crypto primitives: AES-GCM box with HKDF, tokens, constant-time compare, MD5
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §3.8, §5.5, §13.

- **box.ts:** `seal(purpose, plaintext, aad)` / `open(...)`. AES-256-GCM with keys from HKDF-SHA256 over `encryptionKeys`, using the salts and infos of §3.8, which are Rust-compatible for OAuth. Format `keyId‖nonce‖ct‖tag`. Typed BoxError. Rotation is open with any key and seal with keys[0].
- **tokens.ts:** random 32-byte hex session tokens, 32-hex Last.fm tokens and session keys, UUIDv4 ListenBrainz tokens, 24-character base32 app passwords; `hashToken` = SHA-256. All take an injected Random.
- **constant-time.ts:** a portable digest compare.
- **md5.ts:** node:crypto MD5 hex.

packages.title: Node composition: main, dispatch, shutdown, systemd notify, admin socket, backups, bundle and guard
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §3.1, §3.7, §3.9–§3.11, §14.5.

- **compose(config, secrets, {transport, connectJetstream, features})** builds the Node Host and IndexCore, then the dispatcher: router prefixes /api/, /health/, /oauth/, /2.0, /1/ and /audioscrobbler/, then static files, then assetMiss. router.ts exports assetMiss and its route table without other changes.
- **RequestCtx** (http/types.ts) gains deps, app, peer and clientIp; env becomes AppEnv.
- **admin.ts:** handlers are mounted only on the admin socket, use the portable constant-time compare, and add backup and oauth prune-kid.
- **main.ts:** the §3.10 startup order and the readiness probes.
- **shutdown.ts:** the SIGTERM drain.
- **systemd.ts:** READY=1, STOPPING=1 and WATCHDOG=1 through an injectable systemd-notify spawner.
- **backup.ts:** VACUUM INTO, integrity_check, rename, retention 7 daily and 4 weekly, backup_runs, the pre-migration backup, and the `backup` extension timer.
- **build-server.ts:** the esbuild bundle worker/dist/node/main.mjs, with `--check` (build, then run `--check-config` against a test config).
- **check-bundle.ts:** rewritten as the Node guard of §3.9. It prints the bundle SHA-256.
- **test/node/support/app.ts:** `startApp({routes, features, clock, transport})` on 127.0.0.1:0 for later in-process route tests.

packages.title: Port the worker-modules suites from workerd to the Node harness
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §15.1, §15.3.

- **Project.** worker-modules switches to `environment: 'node'`, and the harness is rewritten on node-db: `withIndex`, `runAlarmNow`, `reopen`, and a temporary file per test file. Every test in the listed directories moves off cloudflare:test / cloudflare:workers. worker/test/config.test.ts is owned by N3-11.
- **Titles are kept.** The only expectation changes are the named ones: sql-conformance (>2^53 reads refused, multi-statement refused, BEGIN/SAVEPOINT/PRAGMA denied), the rowsRead budgets in status.test.ts and keyset.test.ts re-derived as EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN pins on SQLite 3.54.1, and the workerd-helper existence checks in local-index and isolation, replaced by Node harness checks.
- **Inventory.** docs/verification/node-port-inventory.json lists every test id executed at 3d953a9 (work/ts-test-report.json) with `kept`, or `replaced: <new id>` with a reason. scripts/test/test-inventory.test.ts statically checks that each kept id's title is still declared in its file and each replacement exists.

packages.title: Imports: Last.fm and ListenBrainz sources, uploads, ZIP bounds, staging, dedupe, writer, routes
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §11.

**Job states:** waiting_index → fetching → writing → done, plus paused, failed and cancelled. Driven by the `import` extension timer.

**Sources:**
- Last.fm backward paging (fixed `to`, boundary dedupe, progress guarantee, nowplaying skip, sk when linked). It uses the shared upstream pacing from N3-08 through an injected `Pacer` interface defined here, so the two packages share no file.
- ListenBrainz max_ts paging.
- Uploads (64 MiB, streamed to disk at 0600): fflate unzip with the bomb bounds, and the Last.fm JSON export.

**Pipeline:**
- staging with listen-key dedupe;
- the writer creating import-priority operations in slices of 1,000;
- feedback score 1 → loves;
- staging rows deleted 7 days after done.

**Routes:** POST imports, POST imports/upload, GET list and detail with ETA, cancel, resume.

packages.title: Node live gates (operator-run, blocked by default) and evidence keyed by the Node bundle
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §5.10, §15.

**Ports** of workers_oauth_check, workers_ingest_check, pds_compat_check, ssrf_probe and the socket soak to the Node host (node_*), against an operator-provided deployed origin and real PDS identities.

**New:** devenv_oauth_check, the confidential-client interop against a local @atproto/dev-env PDS that needs an https test origin.

**Rules:**
- Every gate exits 2 with a blocked document listing missing ATMUSIC_LIVE_* names before any network request.
- No gate contacts Last.fm or ListenBrainz.
- Evidence is keyed by the Node bundle SHA-256.
- The gates are never run by the acceptance script (only their no-env behaviour is).
